title: GRACE Risk-Based Scheduling Tool
summary: A hospital operating-department scheduling and simulation tool combining a case generator, scheduler, and simulation engine to evaluate the risk and efficiency impact of scheduling heuristics. Its case_generator module imports SDV's CopulaGAN synthesizer (sdv.tabular) to produce synthetic case population files for schedule generation and simulation.
